title: I Just Wanna Boat! (IJWB)
description: A modpack perfect to play in servers with boat races!
body:
_This is a modpack for you that **LOVES** boat racing!_


<details>
<summary>Selected Mods</summary>

1. BoatHud
2. Camera Utilis
3. Chat Heads
4. Cloth Config
5. EMF (Entity Model Features)
6. ETF (Entity Texture Features)
7. Fabric API
8. Fabric Language Kotlin
9. Iris
10. Lithium
11. Mod Menu
12. Open Boat Utilis
13. perspektive
14. Placeholder API
15. Simple Voice Chat
16. Sodium
17. Visible Barriers
18. Xaero's Minimap
</details>

<details>
<summary>Recommended specs</summary>

- 8GB RAM
- At least 16GB of free space
- NVIDIA GTX 1050 (or higher than 4GB of VRAM)
- Intel i5 (or Ryzen 5)
- Windows 10/11 (macOS Tahoe or higher)

</details>



<details>
<summary>Minimum specs</summary>

- 4GB RAM
- At least 1GB of free space
- Intel(R) HD Graphics 530
- Intel Pentium
- Windows 7 (macOS X)

</details>



**THIS MODPACK WILL NOT BE SUPORTED FOR ANOTHER VERSIONS! Just get updated sometimes!**
